scope: Nineteen production backend objects are recompiled consistently against the isolated mapping-lease overlay; the other 35 combined GPU members are preserved byte-for-byte, including the fresh-health display frontend. The complete 90-object source kernel keeps 341 original aliases, 97 entry names and crypto/IOBSD/init hooks. Every current VM mapping is held per submit because IBs provide no resource-use list. Completion acquires the captured writable set before releasing any lease, and uncertain publication/cache/reset failures keep resources. IOSurface identity authorization/producer registration, physical cache exclusion/reset and iOS boot remain incomplete.
